pages.text: Manual flights and repairs are fine for a beginner, but true magnates automate everything. With the right machinery, your Zephyr fleet can operate entirely on its own.

pages.title: Zephyr Launcher
pages.text: Tired of right-clicking to ignite burners? The $(2)Zephyr Launcher$() allows for true redstone integration. Place it below your hauler. When it receives a Redstone pulse, it will automatically fuel and launch the balloon.
Crafting the Launcher. Pair it with hoppers and timers for infinite cargo loops.

pages.title: Auto-Station
pages.text: The $(2)Maintenance Auto-Station$() eliminates the manual labor of repairs. Supply its internal inventory with materials like wool, iron, and string. When a damaged hauler lands on it, the station will autonomously patch it up.
Crafting the Auto-Station. It features an interface to toggle the auto-repair function on or off.
